documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported strong performance in Q2 FY27 with revenue reaching INR 235 crores, registering an 80% year-on-year growth, driven by robust demand in commercial vehicles, trailers, and the agricultural sector. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions, including the backward integration into seamless and cold-drawn tubes, and the commercial production of extruded axle beams which now account for 80% of current output. While rising commodity and consumable costs have pressured margins, recently concluded price revisions with OEMs are expected to support profitability in the coming quarters. The company remains optimistic about volume growth in H2 FY27 and is focused on cost discipline, operational efficiency, and expanding its export footprint. Kross Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV segment and consistent demand in trailer and tractor segments.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2, with H2 historically 20% higher than H1.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2. Overall volumes and historically also H2 is always 20% up on H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects export business to be 45% higher year-on-year compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Management expects capacity utilization of expanded capacities and backward integration initiatives to improve progressively over the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The investments we have made in the capacity expansion and operational capabilities are beginning to support our growth, and we expect the utilization of these expanded capacities to improve over the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2, with H2 historically 10-15% higher than H1.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: The company is looking at a growth of 40% to 45% in its exports for the financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

guidance.claim: The plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent and is expected to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent. We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial vehicle demand has been exceptionally good following GST rationalization, with indications suggesting next two quarters will be better.
demand_outlook.quote: Now we see that over the last 2, 3, 4 quarters since the time the GST rationalization has come in, demand from CV has been exceptionally good. And indications do suggest that the next 2 quarters, that is quarter 3 and quarter 4 should be even better.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum in the M&HCV segment continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment volumes in Q2 exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agri segment demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Export sales currently contribute approximately 8% of total component business.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our total component business.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor segment is doing very well and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment are doing better than expected.
demand_outlook.quote: The trailer segment -- sorry, the tractor segment is doing very well and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment is doing better than expected.

demand_outlook.claim: Indications from the OEMs point to a strong September Q2 and subsequently Q3 and Q4 supported by healthy order books.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4. These trends are first time supported by healthy order books.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor industry data for April 2026 remained encouraging and the company remains on track to increase the contribution of tractor segment sales.
demand_outlook.quote: April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging and we remain on track to meaningfully increase the contribution of tractor segment sales to our revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: CV business is expected to grow well in terms of volumes this year with good projections indicated from September onwards right up to March.
demand_outlook.quote: So Mihir, the CV business is supposed to grow well in terms of volumes this year. We have been indicated very good projections from September onwards right up to March.

capex_expansion.claim: The company envisages further expansion through a strategic increase in axle shaft production, forward integration into cold drawn tubes, and enhanced investment in robotic automation.
capex_expansion.quote: The company further envisages expansion through strategic increase in axle shaft production, forward integration into manufacturing by making Cold Drawn Tubes and enhanced investment in robotic automation for forging operations as well as machining facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The total budgeted cost for the seamless tube project is approximately INR 170 crores, funded by INR 110 crores via term loan and the rest from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: the total budgeted cost is approximately INR170 crores, okay? Out of this is funded by INR110 crores via term loan. The rest is from internal accruals, okay?

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced, with current capacity at 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced • Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: Tipping jack installed capacity is 800 kits per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The extrusion line has been finally commissioned and productionized.
capex_expansion.quote: We have finally commissioned and productionized our extrusion line.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track with the piercing mill received and sizing and straightening mills on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, which will double foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 EBITDA margin stood at 13% with revenue of INR 235 crores.
margins_costs.quote: During Q2 FY '27, revenue from operations stood at INR235 crores, registering a growth of 80%. EBITDA was INR 30.6 crores and EBITDA margins of 13%, while profit after tax stood at INR (197) million, reflecting to a year-on-year change of 143%.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support margins during Q3 and Q4.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Using in-house seamless tubes for the trailer segment is expected to yield a margin of approximately 3% to 4% on the overall business.
margins_costs.quote: Well, the backward integration is going to be used for our trailer segment that is on our axles. And then on -- basically on our axle front, we should be having -- on the overall business, we should be having a margin of approximately 3% to 4% once we use our own seamless tubes for it.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 EBITDA grew 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 trailer axle volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of the company's component business.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our component business.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2, the trailer segment contributed close to 49% of revenue, while the component business contributed the balance 51%.
orders_capacity.quote: our trailer segment has contributed close to 49% of our revenue, while the component business contributed the balance 51%.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 226 tipping jacks in Q1 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall axle volume in Q1 was almost at 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes were at around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity to manufacture tipping jacks is 800 numbers a month.
orders_capacity.quote: So as far as the utilization of it, we have a capacity to manufacture 800 numbers a month.

capital_allocation.claim: The company undertook a preferential issue to the tune of INR 63.6 crores to focus on capacity expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The seamless tube project is funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Funded through a mix of debt & internal accruals

capital_allocation.claim: Fund utilization from the IPO has been fully utilized as per the plan.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

risks_headwinds.claim: The months of June and July are periods where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to undertake production trials for the seamless tube facility in February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: By Q3 or Q4, the company will be producing trailer axles exclusively through the extruded beam process.
management_commitments.quote: This particular aspect of business by Q3 or Q4, we will be producing our trailer axles in this methodology only by the extruded beam process.

management_commitments.claim: Further volume scale-up for tipping jacks is expected in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further volume scale-up is expected in H2 FY27 through a structured approach focused on product validation and customer satisfaction

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the new Swedish customer's parts under validation to bring in order books from H2 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Our couple of parts are getting -- are under validation. We should see order books coming in from that supplier from H2 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The axle shaft production facility is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are expected by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think by end of this financial year, we should be doing some production trials.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
